plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and build a cash buffer.
Add to QQQI to increase income-generating assets.
Maintain CRWD at 15% as a quality tech holding.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a significant cash buffer.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and building cash, but also limits upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to reduce leveraged ETF risk to acceptable levels.
Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and free up capital.
Add to CRWD to maintain exposure to a strong tech name.
Initiate a new position in NOW, a top scanner setup.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% per month by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name. It aims for risk-first growth with a moderate cash buffer.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to reduce broad index concentration.
Increase SOXL and SPAL exposure to 6% each, leaning into leveraged ETFs.
Add to CRWD to maintain strong exposure in a high-conviction tech name.
Initiate a new position in NOW, a top scanner setup, with increased allocation.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing leverage and concentration in top setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month by increasing leveraged ETF exposure and concentrating on high-scoring scanner setups. Expect higher potential gains but also significantly larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay.

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to remove speculative leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash for income deployment.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce exposure to a high-beta single name.
Significantly increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and capital preservation over growth.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month through distributions from income-oriented ETFs like QQQI. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income, accepting lower growth potential and still carrying NAV risk in market downturns.
